Internal helper: the descriptives table from one or more jdesc() results

Source: R/tables.R
dot-jst_table_build_desc.Rd

Rows from .jst_apa_terms() on each result in turn, so several results stack into one table. Role headings come from headings (a named list of variables) or from the names of a list of results; under a heading its variables are indented. The columns are the style's descriptives columns; a mean and an SD take the style's decimals, a minimum and a maximum the places the data carry (they are values of the variable, not statistics), n is a count. The general note opens on N (the cases in the pool) when note.n is yes, then carries the user's text; each specific note's mark is assigned by the style (letters or symbols) and set on its rows' labels.

Usage

.jst_table_build_desc(
  results,
  style,
  headings = NULL,
  markers = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  note = NULL
)

Arguments

results

A list of jst_desc results; names are headings.

style

The style list.

headings

A named list: each heading's variables (or NULL).

markers

A named list: each specific note's variables (or NULL).

title

The user's title, or NULL for the type's template.

note

The user's general note, or NULL.

Value

A jst_table.
